question: How is the constant washing of the mouth interpreted in relation to Brahman?
premises: Washing of the mouth is done constantly
It is directed upward toward Brahman
The instruction is addressed to the beloved
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is understood as directed upward toward Brahman.
uncertainties: Whether this is literal cleansing or symbolic internal practice is ambiguous
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is directed upward toward Brahman.
